scripts.lint:web: if [ -d apps/web/node_modules ]; then npm --workspace apps/web run lint; else echo 'Skipping web lint (install dependencies first)'; fi
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && cd apps/api && python3 -m compileall app
scripts.test: cd apps/api && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
